```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-q","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":128}'
```

nina: We'll need pod logs + node GPU metrics for that timeframe. Can you run these on the dedicated cluster (sanitized commands below) and attach output to a debug bundle: 

```bash

kubectl -n prod logs deployment/inference --since=15m | sed -n '1,200p' > /tmp/inference_tail.log

ssh gpu-node-01 'sudo dmesg --time-format iso | tail -n 200' > /tmp/node_dmesg.log
ssh gpu-node-01 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv' > /tmp/nvidia_sample.csv
# then bundle /tmp/*.log and upload via support debug-bundle tool
support-bundle create --cluster dc-eu-14 --out dbg-<id>.tar.gz
```
